content.text:
Generate a 3D model of an octopus chef at a ramen booth

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector

# clear
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT'); bpy.ops.object.delete()
for d in (bpy.data.meshes,bpy.data.curves,bpy.data.materials,bpy.data.cameras,bpy.data.lights):
    pass

def mat(name,color,rough=0.6,metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes=True
    b=m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]; b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*color,1); b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough; b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    return m

M={}
M['skin']=mat("OctopusSkin",(0.85,0.25,0.35),0.35)
M['skin2']=mat("OctopusBelly",(1.0,0.65,0.55),0.4)
M['white']=mat("White",(0.95,0.95,0.92),0.5)
M['black']=mat("Black",(0.05,0.05,0.08),0.3)
M['wood']=mat("Wood",(0.45,0.25,0.12),0.7)
M['wood2']=mat("WoodDark",(0.28,0.15,0.07),0.7)
M['red']=mat("RedFabric",(0.75,0.08,0.08),0.8)
M['teal']=mat("Teal",(0.05,0.45,0.5),0.6)
M['cream']=mat("Cream",(0.95,0.85,0.6),0.6)
M['broth']=mat("Broth",(0.95,0.65,0.2),0.25)
M['noodle']=mat("Noodle",(0.98,0.85,0.45),0.5)
M['green']=mat("Green",(0.2,0.7,0.25),0.5)
M['egg']=mat("EggYolk",(1.0,0.7,0.05),0.4)
M['metal']=mat("Metal",(0.7,0.72,0.75),0.3,0.8)
M['lantern']=mat("Lantern",(1.0,0.35,0.15),0.5)
M['floor']=mat("Floor",(0.18,0.16,0.2),0.9)
# emissive lantern
bsdf=M['lantern'].node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]; bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(1,0.4,0.1,1); bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=1.2

def box(name,loc,scale,material,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=scale; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o
def sphere(name,loc,scale,material):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=32,ring_count=16,location=loc); o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True); bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o
def cyl(name,loc,radius,depth,material,rot=(0,0,0),verts=32):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts,radius=radius,depth=depth,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o
def cone(name,loc,r1,r2,depth,material,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=32,radius1=r1,radius2=r2,depth=depth,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o
def torus(name,loc,major,minor,material,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major,minor_radius=minor,major_segments=32,minor_segments=12,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o
def curve_tube(name,pts,radius,material,taper=True):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); cu.dimensions='3D'; cu.resolution_u=8; cu.bevel_depth=radius; cu.bevel_resolution=4; cu.fill_mode='FULL'
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(pts)-1)
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):
        bp=sp.bezier_points[i]; bp.co=p; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
        bp.radius = (1 - i/(len(pts))*0.75) if taper else 1.0
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    if material: cu.materials.append(material)
    return o

# Floor
box("Floor",(0,-0.3,-0.05),(9,7,0.1),M['floor'])
# Booth counter
box("CounterFront",(0,0.4,0.55),(4.2,0.25,1.1),M['wood2'])
box("CounterTop",(0,0.1,1.15),(4.4,1.1,0.12),M['wood'])
box("CounterSideL",(-2.05,0.1,0.55),(0.2,0.9,1.1),M['wood2'])
box("CounterSideR",(2.05,0.1,0.55),(0.2,0.9,1.1),M['wood2'])
# back shelf
box("BackShelf",(0,-1.2,1.4),(4.2,0.5,0.1),M['wood'])
# posts
for x in (-2.05,2.05):
    for y in (0.55,-1.3):
        box(f"Post{x}{y}",(x,y,1.6),(0.18,0.18,3.2),M['wood2'])
# roof
box("Roof",(0,-0.35,3.35),(4.9,2.6,0.15),M['red'],rot=(math.radians(8),0,0))
box("RoofBeam",(0,0.65,3.05),(4.6,0.18,0.18),M['wood2'])
# noren curtains (red panels hanging front)
for i,x in enumerate([-1.6,-0.8,0,0.8,1.6]):
    box(f"Noren{i}",(x,0.68,2.62),(0.72,0.05,0.75),M['red'])
# sign board
box("Sign",(0,0.72,3.05),(2.2,0.08,0.45),M['cream'])
# text RAMEN
bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=(0,0.78,3.05),rotation=(math.radians(90),0,0))
t=bpy.context.active_object; t.name="SignText"; t.data.body="RAMEN"; t.data.align_x='CENTER'; t.data.align_y='CENTER'; t.data.size=0.32; t.data.extrude=0.02; t.data.materials.append(M['red'])
# lanterns
for x in (-1.8,-0.6,0.6,1.8):
    cyl(f"LanternString{x}",(x,0.7,2.95),0.015,0.25,M['black'])
    sphere(f"Lantern{x}",(x,0.7,2.72),(0.18,0.18,0.22),M['lantern'])
    torus(f"LanternRing{x}",(x,0.7,2.72),0.18,0.015,M['black'],rot=(0,0,0))
# stools front
for x in (-1.4,0,1.4):
    cyl(f"StoolTop{x}",(x,1.35,0.65),0.32,0.1,M['red'])
    cyl(f"StoolLeg{x}",(x,1.35,0.3),0.06,0.6,M['wood2'])

# Octopus behind counter (y=-0.55, head centre)
head_c=(0,-0.55,1.85)
sphere("OctopusHead",head_c,(0.85,0.78,0.95),M['skin'])
sphere("OctopusBelly",(0,-0.25,1.45),(0.6,0.45,0.6),M['skin2'])
# spots
for i,(x,y,z) in enumerate([(-0.5,-0.9,2.2),(0.55,-0.85,2.35),(-0.3,-1.05,1.9),(0.4,-1.0,1.7)]):
    sphere(f"Spot{i}",(x,y,z),(0.12,0.08,0.12),M['skin2'])
# eyes front (+y direction is front toward customers/camera)
for sx in (-0.32,0.32):
    sphere(f"EyeWhite{sx}",(sx,0.12,2.05),(0.16,0.12,0.19),M['white'])
    sphere(f"EyePupil{sx}",(sx,0.22,2.08),(0.08,0.06,0.10),M['black'])
    sphere(f"EyeGlint{sx}",(sx+0.03,0.27,2.14),(0.025,0.02,0.025),M['white'])
# smile + cheeks
torus("Smile",(0,0.18,1.78),0.14,0.025,M['black'],rot=(math.radians(20),0,math.radians(180)))
for sx in (-0.55,0.55):
    sphere(f"Cheek{sx}",(sx,0.08,1.85),(0.13,0.06,0.09),mat(f"CheekM{sx}",(1,0.5,0.5),0.6))
# chef hat
cyl("HatBand",(0,-0.55,2.72),0.58,0.35,M['white'])
sphere("HatTop",(0,-0.55,3.05),(0.68,0.62,0.45),M['white'])
sphere("HatTop2",(-0.3,-0.55,2.95),(0.35,0.35,0.3),M['white'])
sphere("HatTop3",(0.3,-0.55,2.95),(0.35,0.35,0.3),M['white'])
# hachimaki? red band below hat
cyl("Headband",(0,-0.55,2.48),0.84,0.16,M['red'])
# bowtie / scarf
torus("Scarf",(0,-0.35,1.15),0.38,0.09,M['teal'],rot=(math.radians(70),0,0))

# Tentacles: 8 curves from base of head outward over counter
base=(0,-0.55,1.15)
tent_defs=[
 [(-0.5,-0.6,1.2),(-1.2,-0.4,1.25),(-1.7,0.0,1.3),(-1.9,0.35,1.55)], # left holding bowl area
 [(-0.35,-0.4,1.1),(-0.9,0.0,1.2),(-1.3,0.3,1.45),(-1.25,0.45,1.7)], # chopsticks
 [(-0.2,-0.7,1.1),(-0.5,-1.0,1.3),(-0.7,-1.2,1.55),(-0.6,-1.15,1.8)], # back left up
 [(0.0,-0.5,1.05),(0.0,0.05,1.22),(0.15,0.35,1.3),(0.35,0.45,1.5)], # front centre
 [(0.35,-0.4,1.1),(0.9,0.0,1.2),(1.35,0.25,1.5),(1.5,0.35,1.85)], # right ladle up
 [(0.5,-0.6,1.2),(1.2,-0.4,1.25),(1.8,0.0,1.3),(2.0,0.3,1.45)], # right on counter
 [(0.2,-0.7,1.1),(0.6,-1.05,1.3),(0.9,-1.2,1.6),(1.0,-1.1,1.85)], # back right
 [(-0.05,-0.8,1.15),(-0.15,-1.25,1.35),(-0.2,-1.35,1.65),(-0.1,-1.3,1.9)], # back centre waving
]
for i,pts in enumerate(tent_defs):
    curve_tube(f"Tentacle{i+1}",pts,0.16,M['skin'])
    # sucker dots at tip
    sphere(f"TentTip{i}",pts[-1],(0.07,0.07,0.07),M['skin2'])

def ramen_bowl(name,loc,scale=1.0):
    x,y,z=loc
    cone(name+"Bowl",(x,y,z),0.32*scale,0.14*scale,0.22*scale,M['teal'])
    cyl(name+"Rim",(x,y,z+0.11*scale),0.32*scale,0.03*scale,M['white'])
    cyl(name+"Broth",(x,y,z+0.10*scale),0.28*scale,0.04*scale,M['broth'])
    # noodle mound
    sphere(name+"Noodles",(x,y,z+0.14*scale),(0.20*scale,0.20*scale,0.08*scale),M['noodle'])
    torus(name+"NoodleLoop",(x+0.05,y,z+0.18*scale),0.12*scale,0.03*scale,M['noodle'])
    # egg half
    sphere(name+"EggWhite",(x-0.12*scale,y+0.08*scale,z+0.16*scale),(0.09*scale,0.09*scale,0.05*scale),M['white'])
    sphere(name+"EggYolk",(x-0.12*scale,y+0.08*scale,z+0.19*scale),(0.05*scale,0.05*scale,0.03*scale),M['egg'])
    # narutomaki + greens
    cyl(name+"Naruto",(x+0.13*scale,y-0.08*scale,z+0.16*scale),0.06*scale,0.03*scale,M['white'])
    for j in range(3):
        box(name+f"Green{j}",(x-0.05+j*0.06,y-0.1,z+0.17*scale),(0.08,0.03,0.02),M['green'],rot=(0,0,j*0.6))

ramen_bowl("BowlHeld",(-1.9,0.35,1.62),1.0)
ramen_bowl("BowlCounterL",(-1.0,0.25,1.32),0.9)
ramen_bowl("BowlCounterR",(1.15,0.3,1.32),0.9)
ramen_bowl("BowlFront",(0.15,0.45,1.32),1.0)

# chopsticks in tentacle 2 tip + noodle pull from front bowl
for dx in (-0.03,0.05):
    cyl(f"Chop{dx}",(-1.22+dx,0.42,1.85),0.018,0.55,M['wood2'],rot=(math.radians(25),0,math.radians(10)))
# ladle in right tentacle
cyl("LadleHandle",(1.55,0.35,2.05),0.025,0.6,M['wood2'],rot=(math.radians(20),0,math.radians(-15)))
sphere("LadleCup",(1.68,0.28,2.32),(0.12,0.12,0.07),M['metal'])
# big pot on counter back
cyl("Pot",(-1.55,-0.9,1.45),0.38,0.45,M['metal'])
cyl("PotBroth",(-1.55,-0.9,1.68),0.34,0.04,M['broth'])
torus("PotRim",(-1.55,-0.9,1.68),0.38,0.03,M['metal'])
# steam curls
for i,(x,y,z) in enumerate([(-1.55,-0.9,1.95),(0.15,0.45,1.7),(-1.9,0.35,2.0)]):
    curve_tube(f"Steam{i}",[(x,y,z),(x+0.08,y,z+0.2),(x-0.08,y,z+0.4),(x+0.05,y,z+0.6)],0.035,M['white'],taper=True)
# bottles / jars on back shelf
for i,x in enumerate([-1.5,-1.1,1.2,1.6]):
    cyl(f"Jar{i}",(x,-1.2,1.62),0.11,0.35,[M['red'],M['teal'],M['cream'],M['green']][i])
    cyl(f"JarLid{i}",(x,-1.2,1.82),0.12,0.05,M['wood2'])
# menu boards on counter front
for i,x in enumerate([-1.2,0,1.2]):
    box(f"Menu{i}",(x,0.56,0.65),(0.7,0.04,0.5),M['cream'])

# convert curves to mesh for glTF stability
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if o.type=='CURVE':
        o.select_set(True); bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o
        bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
        o.select_set(False)
# text convert too
for o in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if o.type=='FONT':
        o.select_set(True); bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o; bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH'); o.select_set(False)

# camera + lights
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(4.2,5.2,3.2))
cam=bpy.context.active_object; cam.name="Camera"
# point at (0,0,1.4)
direction=Vector((0,0,1.4))-cam.location; cam.rotation_euler=direction.to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
cam.data.lens=38
bpy.context.scene.camera=cam
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN',location=(4,4,7)); s=bpy.context.active_object; s.data.energy=2.5; s.rotation_euler=(math.radians(50),0,math.radians(35))
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT',location=(0,1.5,3.2)); p=bpy.context.active_object; p.data.energy=120; p.data.color=(1,0.75,0.5)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT',location=(-3,-2,3)); p2=bpy.context.active_object; p2.data.energy=60; p2.data.color=(0.6,0.7,1)

scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT' if hasattr(scene,'eevee') else 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
try: scene.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
except: pass
scene.render.resolution_x=1000; scene.render.resolution_y=800
scene.world=bpy.data.worlds.new("W"); scene.world.use_nodes=True; scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(0.08,0.07,0.14,1); scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=0.6

os.makedirs("output",exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.path.abspath("output/scene.blend"))
result={"objects":len(bpy.data.objects),"ok":True}

import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector
def get(n): return bpy.data.objects.get(n)
# shorten & raise noren
for i in range(5):
    o=get(f"Noren{i}")
    if o: o.location.z=2.88; o.scale.z=0.45
# raise lanterns
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.name.startswith("Lantern") and not o.name.startswith("LanternString"):
        o.location.z=2.95
    if o.name.startswith("LanternString"): o.location.z=3.15
# fix sign text mirror: flip scale x
t=get("SignText")
if t: t.scale.x=-abs(t.scale.x) if t.scale.x!=0 else -1; t.location.z=3.08
s=get("Sign")
if s: s.location.z=3.08
# raise octopus head group slightly: move head/hat/eyes up 0.15
for n in ["OctopusHead","OctopusBelly","HatBand","HatTop","HatTop2","HatTop3","Headband","Smile"]:
    o=get(n)
    if o: o.location.z+=0.12
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.name.startswith(("Eye","Cheek","Spot")): o.location.z+=0.12
# flip bowls (cone was upside down aesthetic) - rotate bowl cones 180 X
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.name.endswith("Bowl") and o.type=='MESH':
        o.rotation_euler.x=math.radians(180)
# frontal camera lower angle so face visible under noren
cam=get("Camera"); cam.location=(3.2,5.8,2.6)
d=Vector((0,-0.2,1.6))-cam.location; cam.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
bpy.context.scene.camera=cam
bpy.context.scene.render.filepath=os.path.abspath("output/render_front.png")
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

# lanterns back to visible height, only sides remain visible fine
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.name.startswith("Lantern") and "String" not in o.name and "Ring" not in o.name: o.location.z=2.78
    if "LanternRing" in o.name: o.location.z=2.78
